    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'),
                      (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'),
                      (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a NumPy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a two-dimensional matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values, must be nonpositive")
    # Check shape match
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
    # Compute total losses (negative log probabilities)
    L_result = -np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_no_call = -np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)
    # Compute margins
    margin_no_call = L_no_call - L_result
    margin_call_only = L_call_only - L_result
    margins = np.minimum(margin_no_call, margin_call_only)
    keep_mask = margins > tau_filter
    return (keep_mask, margins)
